entry._comment: Step ce of ce_chain (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-ce-chain-design.md): CeEndpoint primary from production's MDC2025 target stops, as prodtools data/mdc2025/primary_muon.json does.

Step dig of ce_chain (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-ce-chain-design.md): OnSpill digitization without pileup. MDC2025ax digitization has a single Output module, and it needs DbService Sim_best v1_5 (an empty DbService fails at makeSD).
Step mcs of ce_chain (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-ce-chain-design.md): reconstruction of the digitized events; needs the same DbService Sim_best v1_5 as digitization.
Step nts of ce_chain (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-ce-chain-design.md): EventNtuple from the reconstructed events (from_mcs-mockdata); needs the AnalysisMDC2025 code tarball.

Rationale for these keys lives in core/pipeline.py, in the comment block immediately above _render_fcl_overrides (Task 14, lifted from Task 13's STAGE_FCL["elebeam_flash"]). Edit that comment block, not this note, when the rationale changes. desc_fmt/output_glob/njobs (Task 6, lifted from the retired STAGES["elebeam_flash"] literal) are per-stage orchestration constants -- desc_fmt is the json2jobdef description format, output_glob is the file pattern this stage emits regardless of geometry, njobs is the default grid job count (mode specs may override via run.jobs_per_stage; AUTORESEARCH_ELEBEAM_NJOBS env var also still overrides it directly, see core/pipeline.py stage_cfg(), which absorbed core/runtime.py's retired STAGE_TARGETS dict on 2026-08-19).

Rationale for these keys lives in core/pipeline.py, in the comment block immediately above _render_fcl_overrides (Task 14, lifted from Task 13's STAGE_FCL["mustops_ce"]). Edit that comment block, not this note, when the rationale changes. desc_fmt/output_glob/njobs (Task 6, lifted from the retired STAGES["mustops_ce"] literal) are per-stage orchestration constants -- desc_fmt is the json2jobdef description format, output_glob is the file pattern this stage emits regardless of geometry, njobs is the default grid job count (mode specs may override via run.jobs_per_stage; see core/pipeline.py stage_cfg()). njobs/events tuning history, carried verbatim from the retired STAGES["mustops_ce"] comment: 100 jobs per A/B noise test on helical001 (2026-05-16) -- half-vs-half ce_seen agreed to 0.4% at 97 jobs each, well below GP noise floor. njobs=200 (then core/runtime.py STAGE_TARGETS, retired 2026-08-19 into core/pipeline.py stage_cfg()) paired with events=2500 preserves total CE statistics at 500k events while halving per-job wall-time and doubling per-cluster parallelism. 2026-05-21 PM: SR00_00's long-tail (dx=0.011 -> N_crit~4144 -> 3-4h CPU/job, 5x normal) showed the implicit throughput gate; halving events_per_job halves per-job CPU cost at constant total statistics. The earlier 2026-05-21 AM reversion to events_per_job=5000 was made WITHOUT compensating njobs, which halved stats and moved sigma(sob) 0.10 -> 0.14; the 200x2500 pairing restores it. Stamped at submit -- see wiki/incidents/events-per-job-mid-flight-edit.md. MaxEventsToSkip is 8000 here, in the template: the prolog leaves it nil and art aborts at ResamplingMixer construction without it; a dir: inloc gets no SAM auto-compute; and each job reads ONE staged mubeam file of about 16k events, so the random skip must stay below the smallest plausible file.
